podcast.title: Dave Grohl Joins as Second Guitarist
podcast.body: Dave Grohl joined Freak Baby as a second guitarist in mid-1984, marking another step in his early band career. "Next up was Freak Baby, which Dave joined as a second guitarist in mid-1984."

podcast.title: Meeting Barrett Jones
podcast.body: It was through his involvement with Freak Baby that Dave Grohl met Barrett Jones, who would later record the band. "it was through them that Dave met someone named Barrett Jones"

podcast.title: Transition to Mission Impossible
podcast.body: Freak Baby underwent a transformation, morphing into the band Mission Impossible around the time of Dave Grohl's 16th birthday in January 1985. "Then Freak Baby morphed into Mission Impossible, which happened around Dave's 16th birthday in January of 1985."

xref.title: Evolution from Freak Baby (1985)
xref.body: The band formed around Dave Grohl's 16th birthday in January 1985, evolving from Freak Baby. This marked Dave Grohl's transition to playing the drums. "Then Freak Baby morphed into Mission Impossible, which happened around Dave's 16th birthday in January of 1985. By this time, David moved to Drums"

xref.title: Transition to Drums (1985)
xref.body: Around his 16th birthday in January 1985, as Freak Baby evolved into Mission Impossible, Dave Grohl transitioned from guitar to playing the drums. "By this time, David moved to Drums, and this is where we finally get to Dave's earliest recordings that we can find."

xref.title: Early Musical Development
xref.body: Dave Grohl began making music in his teens, progressing through a series of short-lived bands that were crucial to his development before joining Scream, then Nirvana, and eventually forming Foo Fighters. These early groups included Freak Baby, Fast, and Dane Bramage, as well as Mishmash Impossible, which notably opened for DC's Fugazi. "A Mishmash of short live bands that went nowhere but were very important to Dave's development."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Taking Over Drumming Duties – Freak Baby
xref.body: Dave Grohl's full-time transition to drums came when he was a member of the band Freak Baby. The original drummer was performing so poorly that Grohl decided to take over the drumming responsibilities himself. "Because when he was in a band called Freak Baby the drummer was so bad that Dave just kind of took over."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Transition from Guitarist to Drummer
xref.body: Dave Grohl did not start his musical journey as a drummer; his first instrument was the guitar, which he began playing at age 12. During high school, he played in various bands, and it was in one particular group, Freak Baby, that he transitioned from playing guitar to drums. He remained primarily a drummer until the dissolution of Nirvana. "His first instrument was the guitar, something he first picked up at age 12."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
